subject: Renewal: add EU & APAC reserved pools + failover playbook
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@nimbus.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: add EU & APAC reserved pools + failover playbook

Hi Olivia / Samir —

Congrats on the traction this quarter. As we discussed in the call last week, your renewal is up next month and you asked for a proposal that expands Dedicated capacity into EU and APAC with clear throughput and failover behavior. Attached is a first-pass commercial + technical summary (Redwood_MultiRegion_Pricing_20260502.pdf). High-level ask from us to you: confirm target regions, expected 95th/99th latency targets for cross-region traffic, and whether KMS/data residency constraints apply.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Add two reserved pools: EU (3x A100-80GB reserved nodes) and APAC (2x H100-80GB reserved nodes)
- Keep US as-is but increase burstable pool by 20% during business hours
- Throughput guarantee: baseline commitment per-region; detailed numbers and SLA in attached SOW draft
- Term: proposed 24 months with a 10% committed-use discount (we can negotiate)

Can you loop Procurement for redlines? If you prefer, we can run a 30-day pilot on the APAC pool before full activation.

Next steps: if you confirm region/residency, I’ll have Rishi produce a runbook for failover and performance expectations.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0132

Attachments: Redwood_MultiRegion_Pricing_20260502.pdf
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@nimbus.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2026-05-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: add EU & APAC reserved pools + failover playbook

Neha —

Thanks, this looks like the right direction. A few clarifying Qs before we share with Procurement:
1) For regional latency: can you commit to p95 and p99 numbers for region-to-region and intra-region? We care most about EU and APAC intra-region latency.
2) Failover: will there be automatic routing in the event of a regional outage, or do we need to implement DNS-level controls?
3) Data residency / KMS: we need keys managed in EU for EU workloads. Can you confirm integrations?

Looping Samir for traffic estimates — Samir, can you confirm expected sustained tokens/sec and peak for EU/APAC?

— Olivia
VP of Product, Nimbus Analytics
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@nimbus.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-02T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: add EU & APAC reserved pools + failover playbook

Olivia / Samir —

Quick technical summary to address Qs: (I’ll produce a full runbook if we proceed)

Regional latency commitments (target operational characteristics):
- Intra-region (EU -> EU, APAC -> APAC): p95 < 80ms, p99 < 180ms for 1K-5K tokens requests (typical gen workloads)
- Cross-region (EU <-> US, APAC <-> US): p95 < 200ms, p99 < 350ms (depends on WAN)

Reserved pool config (proposed):
- EU pool: 3x A100-80GB reserved nodes (steady throughput 3K tokens/sec across pool, burst to 6K tokens/sec for short windows)
- APAC pool: 2x H100 reserved nodes (steady throughput 2K tokens/sec, burst to 4K tokens/sec)
- Each pool supports node-level autoscaling for burst via our dedicated burst bucket (subject to commit limits)

Failover and routing:
- Smart routing by request geo header: primary->local pool, fallback->nearest compatible pool automatically via our control plane (no DNS change required)
- We provide a documented failover playbook and runbooks for DR tests; failover is soft by default (latency-optimized) and can be configured for strict consistency if you prefer

KMS / residency:
- We integrate with customer-managed KMS in region (EU keyrings supported). We’ll add a clause to the SOW for KMS proof-of-integration and key rotation policy.

Attachments: SOW-Dedicated-Addendum-DRFT.docx (technical appendix + SLA matrix)

Happy to run a tabletop failover test during the pilot.

— Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@nimbus.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-03T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: add EU & APAC reserved pools + failover playbook

Olivia —

Thanks for the quick review. Commercial snapshot below (full breakdown in attached PDF):
- Term: proposed 24 months (we're open to 18 months conversation)
- EU reserved: 3x A100-80GB reserved nodes — list price $X, committed discount 12%
- APAC reserved: 2x H100-80GB reserved nodes — committed discount 12%
- Added: 20% burst capacity on US pool during business hours at blended hourly rate
- SLA: regional p99 credit structure in SOW (credit tiers for p99 breach > 10%/month)

We’ll open a DocuSign for the SOW + Addendum once Procurement confirms term preference and residency requirements. HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654/RW-DED-9874

If you confirm term (12/18/24) and KMS residency, I’ll send the DocuSign for signatures and schedule a failover tabletop with Rishi.

Best,
Neha

Attachments: Redwood_MultiRegion_Pricing_20260502.pdf
From: Procurement <procurement@nimbus.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Olivia Grant <olivia@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2026-05-03T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: add EU & APAC reserved pools + failover playbook

Neha / Olivia —

Procurement reviewed the comps. A few items we need to negotiate before legal:
1) Term: 12 months preferable; we will consider 18 months only with stronger SLA credits (we cannot commit to 24 months without an executive signoff).
2) Data residency: must have EU KMS keys for EU workloads and clear data egress limits. Provide SOC2 evidence and KMS integration plan.
3) Capacity change clause: we require the ability to add/remove reserved nodes quarterly and a defined price for capacity additions during the term.
4) Pilot: request a 30-day pilot with limited liability (cap on usage credits) before full activation.

Attached redlines (Procurement_Redlines_20260503.pdf). Also request an on-call escalation playbook for regional outages and a defined failover test schedule (we propose monthly tests for the first quarter).

Regards,
Procurement Team
Nimbus Analytics

Attachments: Procurement_Redlines_20260503.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@nimbus.ai>, Olivia Grant <olivia@nimbus.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-05T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: add EU & APAC reserved pools + failover playbook

Procurement / Olivia / Samir —

Appreciate the clear redlines. Proposed compromise to keep momentum and meet Nimbus' operational needs:
- Term: 18 months (midpoint). We’ll extend the committed discount from 12% to 14% for the 18-month term.
- Regional pools: we commit to provisioning EU (3x A100-80GB reserved) and APAC (2x H100-80GB reserved) at go-live.
- Throughput & SLA guarantees: baseline pool throughput commitments per region (EU 3K tokens/sec, APAC 2K tokens/sec). We’ll guarantee p99 < 200ms intra-region in the SOW; credit schedule included in the addendum.
- Capacity changes: quarterly capacity change window + pre-negotiated uplift price for additional reserved nodes.
- Pilot & tests: 30-day pilot for APAC with limited liability; monthly failover drills for the first 3 months (Redwood will provide a playbook and runbook).
- KMS/SOC2: we’ll provide SOC2 Type II evidence and a KMS integration plan for EU keyrings; clause will be added to the SOW.

Next steps: I’ll publish the SOW to DocuSign with these agreed points and a tracked addendum for Procurement redlines. Signing link: https://www.docusign.com/en/example/some-docusign-link-9874

If this looks acceptable, please confirm and we’ll route to Legal for final sign-off and schedule the pilot kickoff.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0132
